normalisation: JSON array in listed order with keys sorted and compact separators

rules.name: Negative ROI protection
rules.condition: Penalise Increase when ROI is negative

rules.name: Low conversion protection
rules.condition: Penalise Increase when conversion rate is below 8%

rules.name: Low CTR protection
rules.condition: Penalise Increase when CTR is below 3%

rules.name: Low engagement protection
rules.condition: Penalise Increase when engagement is below 5

rules.name: Evidence sufficiency
rules.condition: Penalise decisive action below 500 clicks or 50 conversions

rules.name: Strong signal protection
rules.condition: Penalise Reduce when at least two performance signals are strong

rules.name: Exceptional performance
rules.condition: Penalise Maintain when all core signals are exceptional

rules.name: Acquisition cost protection
rules.condition: Penalise Increase when acquisition cost exceeds revenue per conversion

rules.name: Channel saturation
rules.condition: Penalise Increase when exposure is high but CTR is weak

rules.name: Budget feasibility
rules.condition: Penalise Increase when budget cannot support 50 additional acquisitions

rules.name: Conflicting evidence
rules.condition: Favour Investigate when strong and weak signals conflict
